import_provenance.original_title: Estimating sparse finite-field matrix rank with sublinear queries
import_provenance.original_statement: For n×n matrices over F₂ with O(1) nonzeros in every row and column, how many row/column adjacency queries are needed to estimate rank within additive εn? Yoshida conjectured that Ω(n) queries are necessary in general, despite efficient special cases corresponding to graph incidence matrices.
